definition: A candidate the placed revision loop ran on and did not refuse: no hard fact of its type was broken. A fact the placement could not judge is counted as neither held nor broken. It may be drawn; it is not therefore good.
basis: docs/workbench.md, the Candidate Set since Phase 17: "placed: a green disc, because the placed loop ran and refused nothing: no hard fact of the type" and "a fact the placement could not judge is counted as neither held nor broken".
